stories.headline: Meta defends Ray-Ban glasses privacy row: 'the light sets them apart'
stories.subtitle: Meta's accessibility VP Maxine Williams told RTÉ the recording light sets the glasses apart from other cameras, as Ireland's and Italy's regulators question bystander notice and a UK/Ireland ban campaign passed 9,500 signatures.

stories.headline: Wired: camera-free Audio glasses are Meta's best smart glasses yet
stories.subtitle: Wired calls the camera-free Audio glasses Meta's best yet: 43-gram frames, 12-hour battery, solid open-ear sound and live translation via the Meta AI app — with no camera, so nobody thinks you're recording them.

stories.headline: Doja Cat debuts documentary short shot entirely on Ray-Ban Meta glasses
stories.subtitle: Doja Cat debuted 'Ma Vie World Tour,' a short shot entirely on Ray-Ban Meta glasses, at Meta Lab LA on Oct. 23 — and worked with the Ray-Ban Meta team on six custom 1-of-1 glasses for her tour looks, hot pink favorite included.

stories.headline: Meta AI glasses officially on sale in Malaysia
stories.subtitle: Meta AI glasses are now officially on sale in Malaysia through Ray-Ban and Oakley stores, Sunglass Hut and optical retailers — Gen 3 from about $519, Oakley HSTN from about $506. Another Southeast Asia market joins Singapore.

stories.headline: Meta delays new business terms to Nov. 20 after publisher pushback
stories.subtitle: Meta pushed its revised Commercial Terms from Oct. 30 to Nov. 20 after publishers and Sen. Marsha Blackburn warned the crawling language could sweep up creators' content. Meta says the terms cover ads and business products only.
